display.summary: Permission visibility filters and a translation audit command.
highlights: register_permission_visibility_filter() hides a disabled feature's permissions from the group and user editors and keeps existing grants on save.
manage.py dlux_translations reports missing, undefined, duplicated and untranslated DLUX_STRINGS keys; --fail for CI, --stub for paste-ready entries.
Inline install from a 1.11.0b7 or newer image; older images rebuild first. No new migrations or dependencies.
